name: FedEx Ground Hub - Independence KY (Northern Kentucky / Cincinnati)

fieldNotes.truckGate: z20/z21 satellite shows a cantilever sliding gate spanning the inbound truck lane where the access road meets the property, with chain-link + barbed-wire perimeter fencing on both sides; vehicles visible queued at the gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white ~1-vehicle-footprint booth set beside the lane just inside the gate (z21). Footprint is small enough it could be an unstaffed check-in kiosk; classified as guard shack given major sortation hub, but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single shared paved gate lane with yellow centerline visible (z21) - in/out share the gate; lane count an estimate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron and broad access-road throat give room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: FedEx Ground sortation hub - dock doors with trailers backed in along multiple long building faces (z19 NW/dock views); easily 150+, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dense trailer rows in two distinct lots - NW of the building and a large eastern drop lot east of the access road; well over 50.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved aprons inside the gate before the dock faces allow trucks to hold/queue.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large cross/H-shaped sortation building plus a small ancillary structure; counted as 2.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~612 m N-S x ~1169 m E-W), discounted for the irregular L-shaped property footprint.
